cost_function.basis: Team choice, docs/research/nico-routing-spec.md, v1, 2026-11-14. This is a team choice. Cost = cost_base + cost_coefficient * (slope / slope_limit_deg) ^ cost_exponent. Transparent quadratic heuristic, not fitted to data. Qualitatively consistent with Minetti et al. 2002 (https://iris.unibs.it/handle/11379/540545), measured under Earth gravity. Results are a relative cost ranking only, not a prediction of real energy use.

slope_limit_deg.basis: Team choice, docs/research/nico-routing-spec.md, v1, 2026-11-14. This is a team choice. Referenced to a rover limit: Perseverance autonomous navigation on slopes above 20 degrees (JPL, https://robotics.jpl.nasa.gov/media/documents/2026_RO_AAS_final.pdf). This is not a human or spacesuit limit.

cost_base.basis: Team choice, docs/research/nico-routing-spec.md, v1, 2026-11-14. A flat cell costs 1.

cost_coefficient.basis: Team choice, docs/research/nico-routing-spec.md, v1, 2026-11-14. A cell at the limit costs 2.

cost_exponent.basis: Team choice, docs/research/nico-routing-spec.md, v1, 2026-11-14. Quadratic growth with slope.
